headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds suffered a tough defeat at the hands of the Washington Nationals, who won 7-1. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds, striking out 4 batters.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their teams' lineups and rotations. Griffin Jax, a right-hander for the Tampa Bay Rays, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. Other players who have been placed on the injured list include Cooper Pratt (Milwaukee Brewers), Jack Leiter (Texas Rangers), Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners), Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins), Slade Cecconi (Cleveland Guardians), and Chris Murphy (Chicago White Sox).

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-hander Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-hander Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-hander Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a tough defeat at the hands of the Washington Nationals, who won 7-1. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds, striking out 4 batters.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox 4-3 in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with a strong team effort on both sides. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with 3 hits, while Brayan Bello pitched 4 strong innings for the Red Sox, striking out 4 batters.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-6 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Kyle Schwarber leading the charge at the plate. Schwarber hit two home runs and drove in four runs, while Jesús Luzardo pitched 7.0 innings with 12 strikeouts for the Blue Jays.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. Berry joins the Royals after being acquired in a trade.
